The vendor directly providing **SmugMug** at **smugmug.com** is **SmugMug, Inc.** (also operating under parent/corporate name **Awes.me, Inc.**).

### Evidence
* **Copyright and Legal Notices:** The official SmugMug Support legal and copyright documentation designates:
  > *"SmugMug takes the rights of intellectual property owners seriously and complies, as a service provider, with all applicable provisions of the Digital Millennium Copyright Act (DMCA)... Copyright Agent. SmugMug, Inc. 548 Market St., STE 32047, San Francisco, California 94104-5401 US."*
* **Platform Terms and Policies:** The official website and support pages state:
  > *"Terms Privacy ©2002-2025 SmugMug, Inc."*
* **App Store Listings:** The official SmugMug mobile applications list **SmugMug Inc.** / **Awes.me, Inc.** as the developer/seller.
